sites.name: Ferry Tracker
sites.purpose: Washington ferry arrivals, departures, crossing history and catch-a-ferry requests.
sites.sourceDatabase: Migrated from SQLite ferry-capture.db on jimbrownhome.
sites.notes: Raw capture archives remain protected files. The catch API retains its token requirement.

sites.name: Home Automation
sites.purpose: Control home devices, shades and automations; view weather and device status.
sites.sourceDatabase: Migrated from weather.sqlite3 and JSON configuration/state on jimbrownhome.
sites.notes: Device discovery and control depend on the home network.

sites.name: SiteDock
sites.purpose: Personal launch page and embedded views of favorite websites.
sites.notes: Favorite order, groups and embed settings are application data.

sites.name: FitTrack
sites.purpose: Health metrics, workouts and Apple Health export ingestion.
sites.sourceDatabase: Migrated from Azure SQL; the destination uses public rather than the former fit schema.
sites.notes: The upload watcher runs on jimbrownhome1 while JimBrown is signed in, reading Google Drive.

sites.name: WebBookmarks
sites.purpose: Save, search and organize web bookmarks, including Tampermonkey captures.
sites.sourceDatabase: Migrated from Azure SQL webportfolio on sqlgkhw25ijhyzzy.database.windows.net.
sites.notes: The Tampermonkey capture script uses the private Tailscale API.

sites.name: Plex web UI
sites.purpose: View, rate and skip the current Plex music track.
sites.database: No separate application database. Volume settings: local PlexWebUI.VolumeState.json.
sites.sourceDatabase: Live media source remains Plex Media Server on jimbrownhome:32400.
sites.notes: Only the web UI moved. The media server remains on the original host.

sites.name: WorkLog
sites.purpose: Track tasks, meetings, time, notes and daily work summaries.
sites.sourceDatabase: Migrated from the Azure SQL-backed WorkLog Azure Functions application.
sites.notes: The old Azure application is stopped. CLI and browser use the new host.

sites.name: WebInventory
sites.purpose: Track containers, stored items, photos and QR labels.
sites.sourceDatabase: Migrated from Azure SQL and Azure Blob images; retained source is a backup.
sites.notes: Images: D:\SolutionDeploy\apps\web-inventory\images on jimbrownhome1. Azure OpenAI remains an external integration.

sites.name: Web Portfolio
sites.purpose: Investment accounts, positions, trading, retirement planning and price alerts.
sites.sourceDatabase: Existing Azure SQL retained unchanged. No PostgreSQL migration.
sites.notes: Retirement plan and Fidelity profile are local protected files. Telegram pull: daily 07:30 local; Azure backstop retained.

sites.name: Web Options
sites.purpose: Review weekly options signals, contracts and related trade details.
sites.sourceDatabase: Existing Azure SQL retained unchanged. No PostgreSQL migration.
sites.notes: Owned-contract data also uses the existing Azure Portfolio API and its server-side service credential.

sites.name: Solution directory
sites.purpose: This host directory: site URLs, purpose and database/source inventory.
sites.database: None. Read-only site/sites.json in the solution-deploy repository.
sites.sourceDatabase: Deployment manifests and verified migration records; no database connection.
sites.notes: Maintained inventory, not a live uptime monitor. Local URLs work only on jimbrownhome1.
